notes: PROPOSED 2026-08-31 from the FLOW-12 brief, which asks for lightweight creation and explicitly warns against a huge form. Six steps as STATES of one screen: you can see how far along you are and go back without losing a back-stack entry per field. Identity, logo, cover, description, location and hours are those steps, not six screens. Corrected 2026-09-01: collectionsTouched said "businesses", a collection that does not exist in the canonical schema and had no firestore.rules block. Business profiles are UserDoc records with profileType==="BUSINESS" (admin/types/firestore.ts:181-209, the "Business extension" fields) — this screen writes to /users like every other profile-creation screen, not a separate collection. See docs/09-Roadmap/screen-contract-chain.md.
